architecture: v2 (re-root after the portal return of 2026-11-07: a Pennsylvania sewer authority choosing the Clay Street storage tank that brings combined sewer Outfall 014 to the consent decree's four untreated overflows in an average year, the tank emptied only as fast as the Southside plant has room for its dewatering flow)
slot_note: re-root of the wave 6 slot after the arch 1 portal landing; one architecture per world, so a new world, dataset and shell
niche: a Pennsylvania city sewer authority selecting, for its consent decree's facility plan, which of four storage tank alternatives at the Clay Street regulator brings combined sewer Outfall 014 to no more than four untreated overflow events in an average year of the 2014 to 2025 metered record, when the tank drains into the Southside interceptor at the plant headworks and the Southside plant runs at its hydraulic limit for one to four days after most wet-season storms
answer: Select Alternative C, the 38 MG tank: it leaves Outfall 014 3.0 untreated overflow events a year, where the 26 MG Alternative B leaves 5.7.
answer_source: submission.md, 1. Final Recommendation (generator/deliver.py from the pack; generator/verify.py recomputes)
stakeholder_role: the sewer authority's director of engineering and planning, who takes the tank selection to the board before the consent decree's facility plan is filed

spine.file: outfall_014_flow_monitoring_2014-2025.parquet (Outfall 014's overflow pipe flow meter, 15-minute readings, with the 2019 meter replacement) beside wrp_influent_hourly_2014-2025.csv (both reclamation plants' hourly influent from the plant historian)
spine.entity: one 15-minute interval of discharge through the Clay Street overflow pipe
spine.source: synthetic (constructed in the layout of a sewer authority's flow monitoring export and a treatment plant historian's hourly export)

world.geography: United States, Pennsylvania (Quessling, a fictional river city of about 180,000 with a combined sewer system; the authority, its plants, consultant, people, systems and data are fictional)
world.org_type: a municipal sewer authority running two water reclamation plants and the city's combined sewer outfalls under a federal and state consent decree

layer1: the Outfall 014 meter replaced in June 2019 (cubic feet per second in Eastern Standard Time all year, then million gallons a day in UTC), with the two loggers overlapping for a week
the plant historian's hourly export in local time with the daylight saving repeat and gap, its two plants in one long file, and the 2021 historian upgrade that renamed the influent tags
tipping-bucket rain gauge loggers replaced in 2024 at two of four gauges, the new loggers stamping UTC, and technicians' calibration pours recorded as tips among the rain
the Northside tank SCADA's pump run states every 15 minutes, a dewatering pump rebuilt and re-rated in 2023 that kept its SCADA tag, and the level transducer reset during the 2023 cleanout
the regulator register's interceptor codes, a field service log in free text, and a work order export across a CMMS change
driver: A storage buffer that captures a discharge until it is full empties only through a receiving channel whose spare capacity vanishes for one to several days after each wet event, so in a run of events the buffer meets the next one still partly full; counting each event against an empty buffer, or a buffer emptied at its outlet's rated pace, understates how often it spills, and only replaying the record with the outlet bounded by the receiving channel's spare capacity, read from that channel's own record, prices the size the limit needs.
driver_concrete: Clay Street's tank is pumped out into the Southside interceptor at the plant headworks, and the Southside plant, its sewershed full of groundwater and inflow, takes its 140 MGD hydraulic limit for one to four days after most storms from March to June; the Northside tank, whose plant has room within hours, empties at its pumps' rating and its overflows replay exactly that way, but Clay Street's pumps can only send what Southside has room for, so in a wet spell the tank meets the next storm still full and the 26 MG alternative that clears four events at its pumps' rating leaves 5.7 a year; only the 38 MG tank, at 3.0, meets the decree.
stump: A competent solver replays Outfall 014's metered overflows through each tank pumped out at its station's rated dewatering flow (the continuous simulation the decree evaluates by, which reproduces the Northside tank's overflows since 2020) and selects Alternative B, the 26 MG tank, at 2.9 events a year; the step that lands it there is taking the pumps' rating as the pace the tank empties, when it empties into the Southside interceptor at the headworks of a plant that sits at its 140 MGD limit for days after wet-season storms, so only a replay bounded by Southside's own headroom hour by hour shows the 20 MG tank at 5.7 events and selects Alternative C, the 38 MG tank, at 3.0.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who converts the old meter from cubic feet per second and Eastern Standard Time, joins the two loggers across their overlap, counts events with the decree's 24-hour separation and replays each alternative through the tank dewatered at its pump station's rated flow, checking the method on the Northside tank's record, files Alternative B (26 MG, 2.9 events a year); only bounding the dewatering by the Southside plant's hourly headroom files Alternative C (38 MG, 3.0 a year, with B at 5.7).
domain_test: The quantity that decides the call is the exceedance frequency of a storage-regulated outfall over the period of record, found the way hydrologists find overflow and flood frequency for a regulated system, by continuous simulation of the record through the storage with its outflow bounded by the receiving system; with hospital beds or school places in place of million gallons there is no storm record, no event separation and no receiving plant whose wet-weather recession sets the storage's drawdown.

differentiation.task156: there a pump station's infiltration scales with the sewer length below a fluctuating water table read from a bore, so one response fitted on a dry record understates a wet replay; here nothing scales the inflow: the metered overflows are taken as recorded, and what decides is how fast a storage tank can empty into a receiving plant that stays at its limit for days after storms
differentiation.task162: there each pressure valve acts only in hours its inlet runs above the setting, an hourly threshold with no memory; here the decisive structure is a stored volume carried from one storm to the next, emptied only as fast as another system's headroom allows
differentiation.task118: there a resource drawn from a buffer that refills only partly between consecutive calls responds less with each call of a run, and the run is the decisive step; here the run is the field's own continuous simulation, a rung below the call, and what decides is that the tank empties into another system whose headroom, read from that plant's own record, bounds its pumps after storms
differentiation.task105: there a new outlet wins only its side of the bisector with a sister outlet, a market cut no closed opening could show; here no market is divided: one tank's spills follow from how full it still is when the next storm comes, set by how fast another plant lets it empty
differentiation.task460: there a new zero-rate source displaces the marginal units of the intervals it runs in, weighted by its own profile; here nothing displaces anything at a margin: a stored volume is carried between storms and emptied only into the room a receiving plant has left
differentiation.task127: there a fixed team's spare capacity shows only as the ceiling it held through an earlier surge and caps how many units it can finish; here no team or count is capped: the receiving plant's headroom after each storm sets how much of a tank is empty when the next one arrives
differentiation.task87: there two owed items in one slot cannot both be taken by one unit, an exclusivity the closed record never paid for; here no slot is exclusive: a tank's volume is shared across storms through the time it takes to empty into a plant that stays at its limit
differentiation.task32: there a constraint binds at a finer time resolution than the natural forecast; here the binding limit is on another system, the receiving plant, and it binds through a state the tank carries between events, not within one period

lineage.driver: The extra input an upgraded service level puts into a unit is the part of the unit the old level left untreated, so the average gain measured on units upgraded earlier, chosen because the old level already treated much of them, understates the gain for units the old level barely reached, while their upgraded level less the new units' present input overstates it; only the gain conditioned on how much of each unit the old level already treated, read from each unit's own record under it, carries across to the new units.
lineage.stump: A competent solver takes the Priority 1 collectors' salt per lane-km per severity point less the 424 lane-km's own Priority 2 salt and files 2,600 t at the planning severity, or takes the before-and-after gain of the collectors moved to Priority 1 since 2022 and files 1,500 to 1,600 t; the step that lands it there is carrying an average across streets whose Priority 2 coverage differs, when the gain is the length Priority 2 left untreated and the earlier moves were mostly hill, school and inner-suburb streets Priority 2 had already salted along much of their length, so only the gain conditioned on each street's own Priority 2 salt files 2,200 t.
lineage.driver_concrete: Quellbrook's Priority 2 trucks salt a collector only at its intersections, hills and curves, so a collector's gain on moving to Priority 1 is mostly the stretch between them at the Priority 1 rate; the collectors moved from 2022 to 2025 were mostly hill, school and hospital-access streets whose Priority 2 salt already covered much of their length, while the redesign's 424 lane-km are long flat outer-suburb grid collectors whose Priority 2 trucks salted about a sixth of them, so the moved streets' average gain understates theirs and the Priority 1 collectors' rate less the new streets' own Priority 2 salt overstates it; only the gain read off each moved street's own Priority 2 salt, at the new streets' Priority 2 salt, carries across.
lineage.fate: landed on the portal (2026-11-07): one response filed the golden 2,200 t by regressing each earlier move's gain on its own Priority 2 salt and reading it at the new streets' (100 per cent), the other filed the default 2,600 t and still kept 70 per cent on the asks; conditioning a carried gain on a covariate each unit's history prints is the strong solver's reflex, so the world is spent
